record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.original_question: Let a_n(ω) be a random increasing sequence generated by independent selectors with nσ_n → ∞. Almost surely, for every system (X, X, μ, T, S) and bounded measurable f and g, do the mixed averages (1/N) Σ_{n=1}^N T^n f · S^{a_n(ω)} g converge in L^2 to E(f | I_T) · E(g | I_S)? If in addition σ_n = n^{-a} for some a in (0, 1), does almost sure pointwise convergence also hold?

evidence.quote: Problem 32. Suppose that nσn → ∞. Show that almost surely the following holds: For every system (X, X , µ, T, S) and functions f, g ∈ L∞(µ), we have limN→∞ (1/N) ΣN n=1 T^n f · S^an(ω) g = E(f|IT) · E(g|IS) where the limit is taken in L^2(µ). Furthermore, if σn = n^−a for some a ∈ (0, 1), show that the convergence also holds pointwise almost everywhere.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\sigma_n)_{n\geq 1}$ be a sequence in $[0,1]$ with $n\sigma_n \to \infty$. Let $(\xi_n)_{n\geq 1}$ be independent $\{0,1\}$-valued random variables on a probability space $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mathbb{P})$ with $\mathbb{P}(\xi_n=1)=\sigma_n$, and define the random increasing sequence $a_1(\omega)<a_2(\omega)<\dots$ to be the enumeration of $\{n\in\mathbb{N}:\xi_n(\omega)=1\}$.

Prove or disprove: almost surely in $\omega$, for every measure-preserving system $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T,S)$ (with $T,S:X\to X$ commuting or arbitrary invertible measure-preserving transformations) and every $f,g\in L^\infty(\mu)$,
$$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^N T^n f \cdot S^{a_n(\omega)} g \;=\; \mathbb{E}(f\mid \mathcal{I}_T)\cdot \mathbb{E}(g\mid \mathcal{I}_S)$$
in $L^2(\mu)$, where $\mathcal{I}_T$ and $\mathcal{I}_S$ denote the $\sigma$-algebras of $T$- and $S$-invariant sets respectively.

Furthermore, prove or disprove: if in addition $\sigma_n = n^{-a}$ for some $a\in(0,1)$, then the above convergence also holds pointwise $\mu$-almost everywhere.
artifact.category_tag: multiple ergodic averages along random sequences
artifact.status_search_result: Related results by Frantzikinakis, Lesigne, and Wierdl establish pointwise convergence of similar mixed averages with random sequences modeled on $[n^c]$ ($c>1$), and joint ergodicity results have advanced in recent works (e.g., 2021 onwards). However, no source located explicitly resolves this exact problem (general selector probabilities with $n\sigma_n\to\infty$, in $L^2$, and pointwise for $\sigma_n=n^{-a}$, $a\in(0,1)$). Status appears unresolved in the located literature.

status_evidence.title: Random Sequences and Pointwise Convergence of Multiple Ergodic Averages
status_evidence.snippet: Pointwise convergence for averages 1/N Σ f(T^n x) g(S^{a_n} x) where a_n is a random version of [n^c], c>1.
status_evidence.claim: Related random-sequence convergence results exist but for different parameter regimes.
